content: {"praised":["Stunning visuals and breathtaking landscape shots.","Hauntingly beautiful score enhances immersive historical atmosphere.","Detailed depiction of 17th-century life and native culture.","Emotional, heartfelt portrayal of Jesuit priest’s spiritual journey.","Powerful storytelling with strong thematic depth."],"criticized":["Storyline feels short and underdeveloped.","Native actors lack believable authenticity.","Romantic scenes overemphasized and distracting.","Explicit sexual content unexpected for period drama.","Some confusion about priest’s convictions."]}
